NONE: › written abbreviation for
enclosed (SENT)
› to make an encampment or put someone in an encampment
（使）紮營；（使）宿營；（使）露營
› a group of tents or temporary shelters put in one place
（臨時）營地，營帳

example: Many people are living in encampments around the city with no electricity or running water.
很多人生活在城市周邊一些沒有電力和自來水供應的臨時營地裡。

NONE: › to express or show the most important facts about something
扼要表述；壓縮；概括

example: It was very difficult to encapsulate the story of the revolution in a single one-hour documentary.
將革命的前後經過濃縮成一部一小時的紀錄片是很難的。
She encapsulates the stereotyped image that the British have of Americans.
她概括地描述了英國人眼裡典型的美國人形象。

NONE: › to cover or surround something or someone completely
把…包住；把…圍住

example: The nuclear waste is encased in concrete before being sent for storage in disused mines.
核廢料在送往廢棄的礦井存放之前，先用混凝土密封起來。

NONE: › used to form nouns that refer to an action or series of actions
（用於構成名詞，表示行爲）
› used to form nouns that describe a state or quality
（用於構成名詞，表示某種狀態或性質）

example: violence (= violent actions)
暴力
a performance (= act of performing)
演出
her long absence (= period during which she was absent)
她的長期缺席

NONE: › a serious illness caused by an infection that makes the brain swell
腦炎（一种严重疾病，由感染造成的大腦腫脹）
› inflammation affecting the surface of the brain that may be caused by infection or poisonous substances
腦病，腦病變

T: › to attract or please someone very much
› to have a magical effect on someone or something

example: The audience was clearly enchanted by her performance.
觀眾顯然陶醉於她的演出中。

NONE: › affected by magic or seeming to be affected by magic
被施了魔法的；著魔的，入迷的

example: They met in Paris one enchanted afternoon in early autumn.
在初秋的一個下午，他們彷彿上天安排般在巴黎相遇了。

NONE: › very pleasant
使人喜悅的；令人陶醉的；迷人的

example: It's described in the guide book as "an enchanting medieval city".
旅遊指南將它描述爲「一座迷人的中世紀古城」。

NONE: › a woman with magical powers
女巫，巫婆；女魔法師
› literary an extremely attractive and interesting woman
迷人的女子
› a type of food originally from Mexico consisting of a thin pancake that is fried, filled with meat, and covered with a very spicy sauce
（墨西哥式）辣肉餡捲餅
› a benign tumour (= one that is not likely to cause death) that occurs in bones, especially in the hands and feet
內生軟骨瘤（一種良性腫瘤）

example: Typically enchondromas cause no symptoms.
典型的內生軟骨瘤沒有任何症狀。

NONE: › to surround something, forming a circle around it
圍繞；環繞

example: The house is encircled by a high fence.
房屋四周圍著高高的柵欄。
Villaverde is one of the high-rise districts that encircle Madrid.
馬德里周邊有很多高樓建築區，維拉維爾德就是其中一個。

NONE: › a part of a country that is surrounded by another country, or a group of people who are different from the people living in the surrounding area
飛地（被包圍在另外一個國家境內，和本國其他領土不接壤）；（在其他人群中聚居的）族群，群體：

example: Campione d'Italia is an Italian enclave in Switzerland.
坎皮奧內是位於瑞士境內的一塊義大利飛地。
Compare
exclave

T: B2 to send something in the same envelope or parcel as something else
隨信（或包裹）附上；附入，封入

example: The park that encloses the monument has recently been enlarged.
環繞著紀念碑的那個公園最近擴建了。
Please enclose a curriculum vitae with your application.
請在求職信中附上一份簡歷。

NONE: › surrounded by walls, objects, or structures
圍住的；封閉的
› sent to someone in an envelope with a letter
隨函附上的；附上的

example: He doesn't like enclosed spaces.
他不喜歡封閉的空間。
The enclosed card is for Julia.
隨信附一張寫給茱莉亞的卡片。
formal Please find enclosed a cheque in settlement of your invoice.
茲附上支票一張用以結清貴方發貨清單上的貨款。

C: › [ C ] an area surrounded by fences or walls
圍起來的區域；圍場；圍地
C or U: › [ C or U ] the act of putting fences around land

C: › [ C ] something that is put in the same envelope or parcel as something else

example: an enclosure for the horses
牧馬的圍場
the members' enclosure
（體育場中的）會員觀眾席
An early example of privatization was the enclosure of public land for use by wealthy landlords.
早期私有化的一個例子是富有的地主圈佔公共土地據爲己有。

T often passive: › [ T often passive ] to change something into a system for sending messages secretly, or to represent complicated information in a simple or short way
把…譯成電碼（或密碼）；把…編碼
I or T: › [ I or T ] specialized language to use a word or phrase in a foreign language in the correct way
正確使用（外語中的詞或片語）

example: Many satellite broadcasts are encoded so that they can only be received by people who have paid to see them.
許多衛星傳送的節目都是加密的，只有付費的用戶才能收看。
Some music CDs are encoded with information about the performers and their music.
有些音樂光碟裡加入了包含演奏者及其音樂作品資訊的編碼。
Grammatical information helps learners to encode sentences.
文法資訊可以幫助學習者正確造句。
Compare
decode

NONE: › a piece of writing, speech, etc. that praises someone or something
贊詞，頌詞
› to include different types of things
包含，包括（尤指很多不同事物）

example: The festival is to encompass everything from music, theatre, and ballet to literature, cinema, and the visual arts.
本屆文化節將涵蓋從音樂、戲劇、芭蕾到文學、電影、視覺藝術等各種藝術形式。

NONE: › shouted at the end of a performance to get the performer to sing or play more
再來一個！再唱一首！
› an extra song or piece of music that is performed at the end of a show because the audience shouts for it
（演出結束後的）加演節目；

example: We were shouting for an encore.
我們高喊著要求再演一個節目。
They did a few old hits as/for an encore.
因爲觀眾要求加演，他們演奏了幾首過去風靡一時的曲目。

NONE: › a meeting, especially one that happens by chance
偶然相遇，邂逅，不期而遇
› an occasion when people have sex, usually with someone they have not met before
（對象通常爲陌生人的）性經歷
› an occasion when two teams play against each other
（體育）比賽，交鋒

T: 邂逅，不期而遇，偶然碰到
B2 to experience something, especially something unpleasant
遭遇，遇到（尤指不愉快的事情）

example: I had an alarming encounter with a wild pig.
我曾經意外地碰到過一頭野豬，真是驚險。
This meeting will be the first encounter between the party leaders since the election.
這是自大選以來兩黨領導人首次狹路相逢。
On their way home they encountered a woman selling flowers.
在回家的路上他們碰到一位賣花的女子。
When did you first encounter these difficulties?
你甚麽時候開始遇到這些困難的？
The army is reported to be encountering considerable resistance.
據報道，部隊正遭遇到頑強的抵抗。

NONE: B1 to make someone more likely to do something, or to make something more likely to happen
刺激，激勵；促進；助長
B1 to talk or behave in a way that gives someone confidence to do something
（透過言語或行動）鼓勵，支援

example: [ T + to infinitive ] We were encouraged to learn foreign languages at school.
在校時，學校鼓勵我們學習外語。
The council is encouraging the development of the property for both employment and recreation.
市政委員會鼓勵開發該項房地産旨在於促進就業和增加娛樂設施。
They've always encouraged me in everything I've wanted to do.
不論我想做甚麽，他們總是會鼓勵我。

NONE: › having more confidence or hope about something
受到鼓舞的；信心倍增的

example: She felt encouraged by their promise of support.
他們承諾支援她，這使她感到備受鼓舞。

NONE: B2 words or behaviour that give someone confidence to do something
鼓勵，激勵
› words or behaviour that make something more likely to happen
促進；激發

example: Children need lots of encouragement from their parents.
孩子需要父母的不斷鼓勵。
I could never have achieved this without the encouragement of my husband and family.
如果沒有我丈夫和家人的鼓勵，我永遠都不可能取得這樣的成就。
We give positive encouragement to applications from older candidates.
我們非常歡迎年長一些的人士遞交申請。

NONE: B2 making you feel more confidence or hope
令人鼓舞的；振奮人心的

example: There was a lot of positive feedback, which was very encouraging.
正面的回應紛至遝來，非常振奮人心。

NONE: › to gradually take away someone else's rights, or to take control of someone's time, work, etc.
逐步侵犯（權利）；慢慢侵佔（時間）；逐漸干擾（工作）
› to gradually cover more and more of an area of land
侵蝕，蠶食（土地）

example: What the company is proposing encroaches on the rights of individuals.
公司打算做的這件事侵犯了個人的權利。
I resent it that my job is starting to encroach on my family life.
我的工作開始佔據本來屬於我家庭生活的時間，我很討厭這一點。
They have promised that the development will not encroach on public land.
他們已經承諾這項開發不會侵佔公共土地。

NONE: › the act of gradually taking away someone else's rights, or taking control of someone's time, work, etc.
逐步侵犯（權利）；慢慢侵佔（時間）；逐漸干擾（工作）

example: The new censorship laws are serious encroachments on freedom of expression.
新的審查法是對言論自由的嚴重侵犯。

NONE: incrustation
› covered with something hard or decorative
覆有硬殼的；有裝飾外層的

example: She arrived home with her knees encrusted with mud.
她回到了家，膝蓋上黏了一層泥巴。
The manuscript is bound in gold and silver and encrusted with jewels.
手抄本封面是金銀裝幀的，上面嵌滿了珠寶。

NONE: › to change electronic information or signals into a secret code (= system of letters, numbers, or symbols) that people cannot understand or use on normal equipment
將…譯成密碼；把…編碼；把…加密

example: Your financial information is fully encrypted and cannot be accessed.
有關你財務狀況的資訊已被完全加密，別人無法看到。

NONE: › to weigh someone or something down, or to make it difficult for someone to do something
使…負擔沈重；妨礙，阻礙；拖累

example: Today, thankfully, women tennis players are not encumbered with/by long, heavy skirts and high-necked blouses.
幸好今天的女子網球運動員打球時不用受笨重的長裙和高領襯衫的束縛了。

NONE: › used to form nouns showing a state or quality
（用於構成名詞，表示狀況或性質）

example: her long presidency (= time during which she was president)
她漫長的總裁任期
a difficult pregnancy (= time during which a woman is pregnant)
艱辛的十月懷胎

NONE: › a book or set of books containing many articles arranged in alphabetical order that deal either with the whole of human knowledge or with a particular part of it, or a similar set of articles on the internet
百科全書；（某一學科的）專科全書，大全

example: The Cambridge Encyclopedia of Language
劍橋語言百科全書

NONE: › containing a lot of information
信息量大的；知識淵博的
› covering a large range of knowledge, often in great detail
百科全書似的；包羅萬象的；博學的

example: her encyclopedic knowledge of France
她關於法國的廣博知識
